attchmntText: Asahi Songwon Colors Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Asahi Songwon Colors Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board considered and approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. These results are accompanied by Limited Review Reports issued by the Statutory Auditors. The meeting commenced at 11.30 AM and concluded at 01.30 PM. The financial results and reports are available on the company website at www.asahisongwon.com.
